acceptedClaims: Harness structured-result-v1 guarantees caller-constrained structured transport and canonical decoding, not domain semantic admission; this remains the correct responsibility boundary.

A schema-valid structured result can be semantically inconsistent. The deterministic injected result evidenceVerdict=unknown plus commitment=commit-b passed the real DeepSeek structured-result parser.

The existing OrdivonAgentLoop conclusion gate is mechanically sufficient to reject a model-correctable domain inconsistency before terminal candidate completion and expose the rejection to a second model turn; the deterministic gate rejected once and then accepted unknown plus abstain.

Semantic cross-field consistency and owner truth admission are separate responsibilities. A consistency gate can reject mismatched verdict/commitment fields but cannot make a wrong internally consistent verdict true.

Owner admission can safely reject a structured verdict only where the owner supplies a legitimate executable rule or authoritative evidence for that exact claim; evaluator independence alone does not create truth authority.

Across 48 counted live decisions over eight predeclared cases, SCHEMA_ONLY, CONSISTENCY_GATE, and OWNER_ADMISSION_GATE each produced 16/16 truth-correct, commitment-correct, semantically consistent results with zero natural correction turns.

The live campaign therefore supplies no evidence that every structured completion needs a new global Harness semantic verifier or mandatory extra model pass when the caller contract and owner law are already explicit.

The prior A10 structured-answer/rationale disagreement remains valid evidence that callers must not mistake schema-valid decoding for admission, even though the low-frequency mismatch did not recur in this bounded campaign.

Free-form rationale is explanatory model output, not a second authority plane. Semantics that matter to downstream commitment should be represented in explicit checkable fields or recomputed from owner-native evidence.
rejectedClaims: Harness should infer domain truth from free-form rationale or hidden chain of thought.
The structured result codec should automatically become a universal semantic verifier.
A schema-valid result is necessarily semantically self-consistent or true.
A semantically self-consistent result is necessarily owner-admissible truth.
The conclusion gate should be globally mandatory for all structured results regardless of downstream consequence or available owner invariant.
The absence of natural live corrections proves that conclusion admission is unnecessary.
A caller/domain gate gains authority to invent a truth oracle simply because it is independent from the model.
The one unsaved gated observation from the failed apparatus run may be counted in live accuracy.

worldModelDisposition.knowledgeCandidate: Structural validity, semantic consistency, owner truth admission, and downstream effect authority are distinct boundaries. Harness may carry a structured candidate without owning the semantic rule that admits it.
worldModelDisposition.harnessExistingMechanism: retain structured-result-v1 as semantic-neutral codec and validate_conclusion as optional caller/domain admission hook
worldModelDisposition.domainGuidance: When a structured field relation is safety- or consequence-relevant and mechanically checkable, encode it in the domain completion/admission contract instead of asking Harness to interpret prose.

nextFalsifiers: Dogfood validate_conclusion in one real consequential owner domain whose admission rule already exists, measuring whether rejection/correction adds value under naturally occurring model errors rather than injected inconsistency.
Test a wrong-but-internally-consistent verdict against an independently authoritative owner observation to confirm CONSISTENCY_GATE cannot substitute for OWNER_ADMISSION_GATE.
Audit Agent-facing observability of conclusion_rejected events and correction budgets before adding any new Harness abstraction.
